body.name: v1.6.1
body.body:
Proper iOS support, and minor bugfixes.  No public interfaces were changed.

### Bug fixes
- Fix crash when passing NULL to `SetConfigValue` for connection user data (#443)
- Listen sockets now reply to stray data packets from an unknown address
  with a "no connection" message, so a peer with a long timeout stops
  retrying promptly instead of sending keepalives until it times out
- Fix `k_nSteamNetworkingSend_UnreliableNoDelay` docs to describe actual behavior (#399)
- bcrypt crypto backend: fix memory leaks and buffer-size checks
- Fix race condition in `Plat_IsInDebugSession` (#430)

### P2P / ICE
- The default ICE implementation now falls back to the native client if
  WebRTC is not compiled in or its DLLs fail to load
- Fix STUN/TURN failover stalling when several server entries resolve to
  the same address (#437)
- Multi-homed hosts: prefer same-subnet candidate pairs, and classify a
  route as local if the peer is on any of our subnets
- Don't queue the same candidate pair for a connectivity check twice
- Fix a race when handling P2P signals during async authentication
- Hardening of STUN attribute length checks

### Platform support
- iOS, tvOS, and visionOS: CMake support, xcframework build scripts, and a
  `BUILD_FRAMEWORK` option.  See `BUILDING.md`
- Android: recognized in CMake, link liblog, fix bionic INADDR_* constants
- Fix TSAN warnings (#429)
- Fix mingw-w64 build (`CMSG_LEN`)
- Fix compile error with some versions of clang
- Fix incorrect argument size in Windows x64 thread-naming code
- `BUILDING.md`: corrected CMake and C++ standard requirements, rewrote the
  macOS section, documented iOS builds

### Tests / CI
- Fix connection state transition bug in example_chat (#269)
- Added iOS CI, a second macOS job building dependencies via Homebrew,
  manual workflow triggers, and scheduled soak tests
- Fixed flaky P2P test harness startup on Windows

body.name: v1.6.0
body.body:
## Native ICE client out of beta

P2P/ICE support is now enabled by default.  The native ICE client has no external dependencies and only adds a small amount of additional code to the library.  (vcpkg feature `ice` and cmake flag `ENABLE_ICE` to remove this)

The WebRTC client can still be enabled with the `webrtc` vcpkg feature or `USE_WEBRTC` cmake flag.  See also `k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_P2P_Transport_ICE_Implementation`.

Changes:

- TURN support (RFC 5766).  This enables P2P connectivity through symmetric NATs where STUN alone is not sufficient.
- IPv6 support
- Numerous bugfixes, better route selection, honor permitted candidate type option.  (See `k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_P2P_Transport_ICE_Enable`)


## Other fixes and improvements
  - SNP reliability fixes: stop-waiting logic and acknowledgment scheduling
  - Fixed a bug decoding reliable message size
  - Fixed endian handling issues
  - Build fixes for MSVC, older Apple SDKs, and TSAN builds
  - Replaced picojson dependency with [vjson ](https://github.com/zpostfacto/vjson/).  This is only needed by the cert tool, which is not compiled by default.

body.name: v1.5.1
body.body:
Minor bugfix release

### Bug Fixes
 - Fix bug decoding reliable message size
 - Fix size limit on SendMessageToConnection variant that accepts a raw buffer pointer
 - Fix code updating reliable segment gap map (#409)
 - Clamp minimum packet number to ack to max packet received (#410)
 - Fix pipe connection send size limits (previous fix applied wrong limit when asymmetric recv limits were set)

### Tests / CI
- macOS was never running P2P tests — fixed
- Run test_connection suite-quick on all platforms
- Build both Release and Debug configurations on all platforms
- Add send_buffer_full test

body.name: v1.5.0
body.body:
This release includes nearly four years of accumulated fixes and improvements.

### API-visible changes
- ISteamNetworkingSockets::SendMessages has updated semantics around failed sends and facilitates retry
- New config options and accessors (ECN, jitter stats, IPLocalHost_AllowWithoutAuth, and more)
- New flat C API for ISteamNetworkingMessages
- New SteamNetworkingSockets_SetServiceThreadInitCallback
- Initial Rust bindings (community contribution)

### P2P improvements
- Fix race bugs leading to hang in WebRTC ICE client
- Numerous bugfixes to native ICE client.  *NOTE*: the native ICE client is still in beta status.
- Re-wrote example trivial signaling server in Python and fixed bugs
- Added P2P to CI

### Significant improvements
- Automatically correct certain out-of-order conditions when possible at both the packet and message queuing layers
- Fix numerous platform/compiler compatibility issues
- Improved CMake and vcpkg integration
- Fix compatibility issues with newer versions of protobuf and abseil
- Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) diagnostics

### Other
- Numerous minor bug fixes in crypto, connection management, and wire protocol
- Security fixes
- CI overhaul with macOS, Linux flavors, more Windows versions
- Added several tests
- Improved P2P test coverage and added it to CI

body.name: v1.4.1 Native ICE client (beta), misc bugfixes
body.body:
Added a native ICE client, so P2P can be done without WebRTC.  This client is beta and is not enabled by default, unless WebRTC support is disabled.  The client does not currently support TURN.

Improvements and bugfixes:
* Fix protocol bug in malicious sender protection, that could cause asserts and possibly dropped reliable messages if packet loss and latency were both extremely high.
* Polling will now use epoll on supported platforms (e.g. linux).
* IPv6 parsing now supports dotted-decimal-style IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses, e.g. ::ffff:123.45.67.89
* Fix deadlock if API calls were made from custom P2P callbacks that needed to lookup a connection by handle
* Public headers no longer #define POSIX, which conflicts with other libraries
* Improvements to platform detection and compatibility on various console platforms

No public interfaces were changed

body.name: v1.4.0 Multi-lane support
body.body:
Version 1.4.0 adds support for multiple lanes, improves compliance with vcpkg best practices, and has numerous smaller bugfixes and improvements.

This brings the library in sync with the Steamworks SDK version 153a.

### Multi-lane support
"Lanes" can be used to control head-of-line blocking behaviour.  You can control the priority level of each lane and how bandwidth should be shared between different lanes.

Lanes are similar to what QUIC calls "streams", and what other networking APIs call "channels".

See `ISteamNetworkingSockets::ConfigureConnectionLanes` for details.

### Misc bugfixes / improvements
* Fixed bug setting the connection userdata via the config var `k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_ConnectionUserData`, which is necessary when setting it at connection creation.
* Simplified iteration of configuration values and controlling when to list "dev" values.
* Added configuration values to configure TURN servers for use by WebRTC
* Improved handling of closing connections in the linger state that did not need to linger.
* Attempt to clean up connections on library shutdown that were left open or in the linger state.
* Added several more tests
* You can now build the cert tool by passing `-DBUILD_TOOLS=ON` to cmake
* Improved cmake files, manifests, and build instructions to improve compliance with vcpkg best practices.  (Some work still remains in this area.  If you are a cmake/vcpkg expert, please help!)
* Added a test/example project that shows how to pull in this library using vcpkg, without fetching or compiling the code directly.
* Removed a bunch of declarations for Steam internal things from the headers
* Added a CI build for windows on github

### Other changes
* The "FakeIP" framework was added to the Steamworks SDK.  That feature requires Steam backend support and is not supported in this opensource code, but the declarations are present in the header.
*  `GetQuickConnectionStatus` renamed to `GetConnectionRealTimeStatus` and now can return information about the status of each outbound lane.   `SteamNetworkingQuickConnectionStatus` was also renamed to `SteamNetConnectionRealTimeStatus_t`.

body.name: v1.3.0 Performance improvements, ISteamNetworkingMessages, and more
body.body:
## Major changes
### Performance improvements
Implemented a fine-grained locking strategy to greatly reduce lock contention, especially if API calls are made from multiple threads.  (See issue #50.)

### Added ISteamNetworkingMessages
This interface is primarily useful for porting existing code that expects to be able to make ad-hoc sendto/recvfrom calls to arbitrary addresses, and does not consistently use the abstraction of a "connection".

## Other improvements
* Header files are now compatible with Steamworks SDK headers.  You can easily switch between using the Steamworks SDK and a standalone library for the networking interfaces in this library, even making the determination at runtime.
* Added a mechanism to customize (most) memory allocations.
* Numerous bugfixes related to P2P and ICE

## Compatibility
Some interfaces were renamed related to custom P2P signaling.  Otherwise there were no major API-breaking changes.  This update is compatible with the Steamworks SDK 1.51 release.

body.name: v1.2.0 Peer-to-peer support
body.body:
* Added support for peer-to-peer connections.
  * NAT-punched connections, using google webrtc's ICE implementation.
  * Plugin architecture for signaling service.
  * Symmetric connect mode
  * For full details, see [README_P2P.md](README_P2P.md)
* Reworked callback mechanism, improving compatibility with Steamworks version.
* Easier Windows configuration using vcpkg
* Numerous bugfixes, etc.

This update corresponds to the Steamworks SDK 1.50 release.

body.name: v1.1.0 Poll groups, no-copy message send, sync with Steamworks SDK 1.48
body.body:
Changes from v1.0:
- Added poll groups
- Added method to send multiple messages in a single API call without copying the message payload
- Added methods to set options at socket creation time, or set multiple options atomically
- Reworked flat interface
- Libsodium support
- Numerous bugfixes, etc.

This update corresponds to the Steamworks SDK 1.48 release.

This is the first release of the GameNetworkingSockets library, coinciding with the [first available version](https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks#announcements/detail/1791775741704351698) in the Steamworks SDK.
 
Version 1.0.x will maintain compatiblity with SteamworksSDK 1.44.
